body.problem: Write a C++17 program that reads one integer N and decides whether N is a prime number. A prime number is an integer greater than 1 whose only positive divisors are 1 and itself (so 1 is NOT prime and 2 is the smallest prime). Print YES if N is prime, otherwise print NO.
body.input_format: A single line containing one integer N.
body.output_format: Print exactly YES if N is prime, otherwise print exactly NO, followed by a newline. Output is case-sensitive; print nothing else.
